items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I had a call from Sydney Lumet to work on a picture called 'Serpico'

ctx.x: Then, on the conclusion of that semester, you were still, I think, conducting work with Hollywood, playing things like the Newport Festival and other things in between. Now, if I remember correctly, at the time you were in Princeton, a couple of opportunities for film writing turned up, which your fidelity -- you became a Princetonian very deeply and very quickly -- which your fidelity to Princeton did not permit you, or prevented you, from taking. What were those opportunities?

Oh, I had a call from Sydney Lumet to work on a picture called 'Serpico' -- and I also had a call from Bill Stinson from Paramount in Hollywood to work on a picture called 'The Great Gatsby' -- and I, at the time, he wanted to know if I ... I think it was on a Wednesday, and he wanted to know if I could go to London on Friday. I still don't ... at this point, I don't remember why, because the picture, I think, was shot ... it must've been shot in Hollywood, but maybe it was recorded in London. I don't know what…
But I do know that after I mentioned it, that I was told by Dr. Berger that they would have allowed me to go
